detail.summary: Autonomous systems can mitigate reward hacking by combining robust max-min policy optimization over correlated proxy spaces with invariance-based stress testing that isolates exploitable sensitivities from genuine performance gains.

detail.title: Provisional Foundations of WAKE Durable Record
detail.summary: WAKE models operational state through a deterministic replay of accepted events, ensuring that current state is never cached but derived from an authoritative, append-only SQLite log. Governance acts as the sole validator for proposals, preventing invalid states from entering the durable chain.
detail.findings:
State reconstruction in WAKE is strictly deterministic, relying on replay of accepted operations rather than a mutable state cache. [source-c07acfeebe1548f6]

The governance module enforces state validity by rejecting invalid proposals before they are appended to the durable record. [source-be48d836aaf44716]
detail.limitations: Current model scope restricted to structural record analysis; lacks runtime verification of concurrent event ingestion.
detail.next_questions: Does the atomicity of the SQLite transaction prevent partial writes when a proposal is rejected during the governance check?
